name: qa-strategy
description: Pre-fill what the codebase shows, then ask only the decision-relevant intake questions (product, stack, team size, release cadence) as multiple-choice option sets, then generate a tailored, risk-based QA strategy with an automation plan, quality gates, tooling, and a phased rollout. Scores features by likelihood × impact to focus coverage where it matters, and defines metrics (escape rate, DORA lead time / change fail rate / recovery time, flake rate, mutation score) with precise formulas and enforcing CI gates. Enforces guardrails against invented inputs, big-bang rewrites, one-size-fits-all strategies, testing theater, and vanity metrics with no gate — every recommendation must trace to a stated intake input and land as a measurable gate.
